cases.customerText:
Hello, I have been a customer for eleven years, first with mobile, then broadband, then TV. In all that time I have maybe complained twice. But now: on the 3rd I noticed the invoice was 549 instead of 399. I downloaded the PDF, checked every line, and found a 'service activation fee' nobody mentioned. I called on the 5th, waited 30 minutes, was told it was a mistake and would be refunded in five working days. On the 12th still no refund. I emailed, got an autoreply, then nothing. Meanwhile my neighbour says her provider includes the sports channels for less. I am not the kind of person who threatens anything, but my patience has limits. Kindly fix the invoice and confirm the refund.

Emoji stress test: 📞⏳ 🏠❤️. Emojis may support or contradict the text; judge the complete customer message.
cases.rationale: Noisy long letter: refund + ignoring + neighbour comparison + 'patience has limits'.

cases.customerText:
Dear Nordbo, I write regarding ticket 88123 opened on the 14th and ticket 90455 opened on the 22nd, both about packet loss on the evening network in my area. I have attached ping logs, traceroutes, and screenshots. I rebooted the router as advised, tried the spare router as advised, and moved the router away from the microwave as advised. The problem persists between 20:00 and 23:00 daily. I work evenings and this affects my livelihood. Your technicians are polite and clearly try, but the advice cycle repeats itself. I request escalation to someone who can examine the area infrastructure rather than my kitchen appliances.

Emoji stress test: 🏁✨ 🧳👋. Emojis may support or contradict the text; judge the complete customer message.
cases.rationale: Deep technical detail, repeat contacts, polite staff (no interaction complaint), no churn signal.

March invoice +60 again (same roaming flag). April: credited after one call, agent admitted a system bug. May: +60 again. I have now been credited three times for the same non-existent roaming and billed for it four times. I no longer wish to spend my lunch breaks on this. If the May invoice is not corrected permanently I will consider my options, including the ombudsman and other providers.

Second, a concern: since the renewal the app shows my old plan, the new discount is missing, and the projected next invoice is wrong by about 90. Since the street works in June the connection degrades whenever it rains - I have correlated this over six weeks with my card terminal failures (card payments fail, customers walk out, I lose real money). I reported it twice; both times your line tests 'show no fault' because it was dry those days. I am attaching weather data. I do not want compensation, I want it fixed. If it helps, the cafe two doors down on another network has no issues when it rains.

cases.customerText:
So here is the story: I ordered the family bundle in November. Installation appointment one: technician never showed (I took a day off). Appointment two: wrong router. Appointment three: works, but the TV part was never activated. Four phone calls, one chat, one email. Meanwhile the invoices started arriving for the full bundle including the TV I cannot watch. Each person I spoke to was individually nice, and I do not blame them, but as a system you are failing me. My wife asks daily why we switched to you. Please: activate the TV, fix the invoices, and someone own this case end to end.

Emoji stress test: 💳💸 1️⃣✅. Emojis may support or contradict the text; judge the complete customer message.
cases.rationale: Order saga; staff individually nice so interaction complaint UNCLEAR-leaning-no, system failure expressed; spousal regret = churn overtones.

I have reset it perhaps twenty times. Your help articles are of no use. The chatbot insists my problem is about invoices, which it is not. Yesterday I finally reached a human who fixed something on the server side, and it worked - for four hours. This morning, locked out again. I write novels for a living and my correspondence is with publishers; this is not a trivial hobby account. I would like this treated as the serious ongoing fault it is.
